article.title: Burning books in Wales?
article.excerpt: It is, therefore, genuinely shocking to learn that book-burning is taking place in south Wales . Pensioners in Swansea are reportedly buying books from charity shops for just a few pence each and taking them home for fuel. With temperatures plummeting and energy costs on the rise, thick books such as encyclopaedias are said to be particularly sought after. I
